fichas.title: Retail Outlet Routeing and Escalators
fichas.summary: Describes retail routeing strategies and vertical escalator arrangements. Routeing can use lighting, fittings and product placement to promote goods and offers. Examples include centric routeing, polygonal routeing, a single loop, self-service supermarket routeing, parallel escalators and double criss-cross escalators. Routes should include corner areas, and the shop layout should support customer movement and checkout control without forcing diversions.
uses: Guide customer movement through product ranges
Provide vertical access between shop levels
